assets.name: common_friends-avatar-dice_icon_normal_v001

prompt.text:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: isolated circular friend avatar portrait for a casual mobile board game UI.
Primary request: create a new original illustration, a single chunky white and light grey rounded six-sided die with deep black circular pips, viewed from a friendly three-quarter angle. Keep the identity as a DIE, not a face or a mascot. The die almost fills an olive green circular portrait disc.
Style/medium: polished soft 3D cartoon game icon, smooth slightly matte surfaces, gentle directional light and readable small-scale shapes.
Composition/framing: one centered perfectly circular olive green portrait badge, canvas square, circle occupies the whole image and touches all four canvas bounds. A rounded white/grey die centered in the disc with large visible black pips. A small amount of olive green remains visible around the die inside the circular portrait. The circle is the portrait background, not a separate decorative UI frame.
Background: outside the circular silhouette is genuinely transparent alpha 0, including all four corner regions. No checkerboard or solid outer backdrop.
Constraints: artwork only. No external UI cast shadow, no shadow beyond the circle, no metallic rim, no border or outline around the circle, no frame, no text, no letters, no number labels, no notification badge, no watermark. Do not add a face or limbs. Preserve clean antialiased circular edges.

assets.name: common_friends-request-kiss_illustration_normal_v001

prompt.text:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: standalone rectangular portrait illustration used inside a small sticker card in a casual mobile board game.
Primary request: create a new original cheerful cartoon illustration of a smiling young adult woman with warm brown hair, shown from the waist or chest upward, enjoying a green nature walk. She has her eyes softly closed and holds one hand directly in front of her lips in a sweet blowing-a-kiss gesture; her fingers touch her mouth gently and her expression is playful and affectionate.
Scene/backdrop: a sunlit green park or countryside walking path, fresh leafy trees, rounded bushes, grass and a few small yellow flowers. The green nature scene must fill the entire rectangle edge to edge.
Subject: friendly warm brown-haired woman with a rounded attractive cartoon face, healthy warm skin, simple blue short-sleeved top. One raised hand in front of the mouth, smiling kiss-blowing pose, other arm relaxed.
Style/medium: polished colorful casual mobile game illustration, soft rounded 3D cartoon shading, crisp readable shapes at very small size, bright gentle natural light.
Composition/framing: vertical rectangular portrait about 3:4, woman centered and large with face and hand clearly readable; a green scenic backdrop behind her. Full bleed artwork, no blank margins.
Constraints: illustration ONLY. Absolutely no sticker card container or UI elements. No frame, no border, no rounded UI card edge, no header, no star, no label, no count, no text, no letters, no logos, no outer cast shadow, no notification or reward badge, no heart icon, no watermark. Do not reproduce a screenshot or a game UI. Opaque rectangular image.

processing.resize: LANCZOS, aspect ratio preserved, max edge 512
